Build only the UI for Interface AI Agent Console. All routes unprotected, no authentication. Use synthetic data and working mock interactions; label demo/simulation and synthetic evidence clearly. No database, backend integration, production publishing, remote browser/VNC/container/input gateway. Future FastAPI/SQLite/in-memory worker is not implemented. Preserve this scope throughout.

Domain: natural-language tasks select an app instance, never require capability IDs. Runs have discovery/replay kind, ordered events, typed inputs and structured outcomes; replay pins exact immutable artifact/version. Capability = stable operation and typed contract. Artifact = immutable plan artifact_id/version/capability_id, typed schemas, saved tools/argument bindings, durable semantic role/name/scoped/parameterized targets, deterministic checks; no stale observation/control/source-call references and no recorded fixed coordinates. Visual point targets reference stored crop assets and deterministic fresh screenshot matching. App instances identify tenant/product/deployed URL/environment/config/UI variant. Bindings separately map (app_instance_id,capability_id) to exact artifact_id, one active binding per pair plus history. Readiness needs compatibility checks, never blindly latest version. Events envelope run_id/sequence/timestamp/type/nullable step_id/payload; discovery step_id null; tool_finished is an event, not resource/table. Inspect exact tool inputs/results/order. Assets relate via run/event sequence, no evidence_asset_ids arrays. Discovery post-tool evidence links tool_finished; replay shows fresh resolution/failure and post-tool evidence; artifact crops are separate assets. /evidence is frontend only, not future repository submission directory. Outcomes distinguish success, expected business outcome, recoverable condition, diagnosed hard failure.
Final review corrections (stage 7, bounded cleanup after the six completed stages). Independent TypeScript check, Vitest routing test, and full Vite production build passed from exported commit 154bdc9967cc5e006db31f19e565b1350edb56d9. Do not redesign.

1. Locked domain correction: finalize_capability currently persists a new capability and run but no artifact. A proposed capability must persist only atomically with successful mock ARTIFACT finalization: create an immutable structured artifact with schemas/steps/checks and source discovery link, record artifact_finalized, set run.finalized_artifact_id. Failed validation/finalization persists neither capability nor artifact; selecting an existing capability reuses it. Make artifact plan/checks appropriate to the proposal's visibly mocked operation; no fabricated real execution.
2. Static design audit found real issues: task textarea uses resize-y; use shared Textarea with resize-none (adequate rows or auto-grow), also ensure shared ui/textarea default resize-none. Global scrollbar needs scrollbar-width:auto in addition to scrollbar-color; add tokenized hover/active and forced-colors handling.
3. Record an explicit native Select/Listbox ownership decision: browser/OS popup geometry is accepted for this demo, consistent shared FilterSelect/form primitives. Add premium-ui.json with ownership {"Select/Listbox":"native"}, sourceRoots ["src"], canonicalMap "UX-CONTRACT.md"; document the canonical UI map with columns Capability | Canonical owner | Source of truth | Allowed variants | Verification, applicable Form/Select/Listbox/Scrollbar/Toast/CRUD rows and actual owners/checks. Reconcile UX-CONTRACT heading to completed stages; keep source-of-business rules as this locked brief.
4. Static audit flags unused calendar DayButton as actionless even though {...props} forwards its handler; make forwarding of onClick explicit while preserving behavior (extract prop/forward once), don't create a new calendar feature.
5. Reconcile DESIGN.md to valid current DESIGN.md schema with concrete existing token values and runtime mapping, without changing the approved palette/typography. Lint if tool available. Use CSS colors and length radii in structured token frontmatter. Run final typecheck, lint and tests and report exact results; verify proposed capability success includes artifact and failed path persists nothing. Scope remains UI-only/unprotected/no DB/no publishing.
